name: 色盲安全配色生成器
ed: Generate colorblind-safe sequential, diverging and qualitative palettes with guaranteed minimal Delta-E, Free, browser-only.
d: 生成在 8 種色覺型別下均可區分的安全配色，支援順序/發散/定性模式、鎖定色、明暗交替策略、8 型即時預覽與 WCAG 校驗。

name: 色盲模擬器 Pro
ed: Simulate 8 color-vision deficiency types on any color, image and palette with CVD-safe suggestions, Free, browser-only.

name: 調色盤色覺可辨識度檢查器
desc: Palette Color Vision Distinguishability Checker - ToolBox
ed: Check pairwise distinguishability of a color palette under 8 CVD types and grayscale with improvement tips, Free, browser-only.
d: 檢查配色在 8 種色覺型別與灰度下的兩兩 ΔE 可辨識度，輸出混淆預警、灰度明度階梯評分與一鍵修正建議。

name: Farnsworth D-15 色相排列測試
desc: Farnsworth D-15 Color Arrangement Test - ToolBox
ed: D-15 color arrangement test scoring tritan/protan/deutan type and severity from a 15-cap sequence, Free, browser-only.
d: 瀏覽器版 Farnsworth D-15 色相排列測試：15 個等亮度色帽拖拽排序，輸出色相軌跡圖、總誤差分 TES、混淆指數 C 與紅/綠/藍三色覺分型判讀。
